title: Magneto Developer
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Magento Developer based in Turkey. As a Magento Developer, you will contribute to the development, customization, and maintenance of e-commerce websites built on Magento 2. In this remote, part-time role, you will work on project-based assignments or monthly contracts, helping deliver reliable, secure, and high-performing online shopping experiences. You will customize storefronts, develop modules, integrate third-party services, and resolve technical issues to ensure seamless website functionality. Working with a range of web technologies, you will help improve website performance, usability, and security while meeting project requirements. You will collaborate with team members to deliver quality solutions within agreed timelines and adapt to evolving business needs. This opportunity is ideal for a developer with a solid foundation in Magento 2 who values flexible working arrangements and hands-on experience with e-commerce projects. Accountabilities Develop, customize, and maintain e-commerce websites using Magento 2, ensuring functionality, reliability, and a smooth user experience. Customize Magento themes, modules, extensions, and storefront features to meet specific project and business requirements. Integrate third-party APIs, payment gateways, shipping services, and other external tools to extend website capabilities. Troubleshoot technical issues, identify bugs, implement fixes, and maintain the stability of e-commerce platforms. Optimize website performance, loading speed, and overall functionality to support efficient and responsive online shopping experiences. Write, test, and maintain code using PHP, MySQL, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and XML. Implement security updates, apply maintenance fixes, and follow appropriate development practices to help protect websites and customer data. Collaborate with team members to clarify requirements, provide technical updates, and deliver project milestones within agreed deadlines. Support ongoing improvements and technical enhancements based on project priorities and evolving business needs. Requirements Between one and three years of hands-on experience in Magento 2 development, customization, and maintenance. Practical knowledge of PHP and MySQL, with the ability to develop and troubleshoot e-commerce functionality. Familiarity with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and XML for storefront customization and web development. Experience customizing Magento themes, modules, extensions, and storefront components. Understanding of third-party API integrations, payment gateway configurations, and shipping service integrations. Ability to identify and resolve technical issues, debug code, and improve website performance. Awareness of website security practices, software updates, and ongoing e-commerce platform maintenance. Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a commitment to producing clean, reliable, and maintainable code. Effective communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to understand project requirements and work independently when needed. Good time management skills and the ability to deliver assigned tasks within agreed timelines in a remote working environment. Availability for part-time contractual work, with flexibility to support project-based or monthly engagements. Immediate availability is preferred. Benefits Remote work: Work from anywhere, subject to the engagement requirements. Part-time flexibility: Balance professional commitments with flexible working hours based on project needs. Contractual engagement: Choose from project-based assignments or monthly contract arrangements, depending on business requirements. Experience-based compensation: Compensation is determined by your experience, technical expertise, and the scope of work. Practical development experience: Work on real-world Magento 2 e-commerce projects and strengthen your technical skills. Technical growth: Gain further experience in e-commerce customization, third-party integrations, troubleshooting, and website optimization. Collaborative environment: Work with a team to deliver technical solutions and contribute to ongoing project improvements.
